US VP JD Vance calls H-1B visa program 'broken', backs scrapping it

US Vice President JD Vance has stated that the H-1B visa program is "completely broken" and expressed support for scrapping it. He accused companies of utilizing the system to replace American workers with foreign employees hired at lower wages.
